title: Assessment of cry1Ab transgene cassette in commercial Bt corn MON810: gene, event, construct and GMO specific concurrent characterization
protocol: Isolate DNA from the test material using QIAGEN DNeasy Plant Mini Kit.
Evaluate the DNA concentration by UV absorption at 260nm and purity by A260/280nm ratio using a UV spectrophotometer.
Dilute the isolated DNA to a final concentration of 50ng/μl and use as stock solution for PCR analysis.
Dilute desalted oligonucleotide primers to a final concentration of 10 pmol/μl with milli-Q water.
Store diluted primers at -20°C until use.
Programme the PCR assay in an epigradient Mastercycler.
Prepare a reaction mixture of 25 μl using 1X QIAGEN Multiplex PCR Master Mix, which contains HotStarTaq DNA polymerase, dNTP mix, and multiplex PCR buffer with a final concentration of 3.0 mM MgCl2.
Add 20 pmol of each primer to the reaction mixture.
Include 10% QIAGEN Q solution in the reaction mixture.
Add 100 ng of template DNA to the reaction mixture.
Set the initial denaturation at 95°C for 15 min.
Perform 35 cycles, with each cycle comprising a denaturation step at 94°C for 30 s, an annealing step at 60°C for 90 s, and an extension step at 72°C for 60 s.
Conduct a final extension at 72°C for 7 min.
Perform Multiplex PCR assay using equimolar primer concentration for each primer set.
Maintain the annealing temperature at 64°C for the multiplex PCR assay.
Carry out the Longrun construct specific PCR amplification.
Mix long PCR enzyme mix, 1X buffer, 1.5 mM MgCl2, 200 μM dNTP, and primer at 0.2 μM each for the reaction.
Set the initial denaturation step at 95°C for 2 min.

Follow with 30 cycles: denature at 95°C for 30 s, anneal at 55°C for 30 s, and extend for 2.0 min for npt-II transgene cassette or 4.0 min for cry1Ab and vip-s transgene cassette with auto-extension of 2 s per cycle.
Conclude with a final extension at 68°C for 10 min.
Adjust the elongation time based on the length of construct-specific amplicon.
Design different combinations of primer sequences for small construct specific assays.
Amplify using the same PCR programme with an elongation time of 2.0 min.
Purify the construct-specific PCR amplicons with QIAGEN QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit.
Use purified template DNA for nested PCR assay.
Set the nested PCR program and conditions as per standard PCR assay.
Analyze amplified products by electrophoresis on a 2.0% (w/v) agarose gel in 0.5X TBE buffer.
Visualize the gel after Ethidium bromide staining using an Alphalmager 2200 Gel documentation system.
For multiplex PCR product, use a 2.5% (w/v) agarose gel.
For DNA quality checks and long run PCR amplicon, use a 1.0% (w/v) agarose gel.
Set the running conditions at constant voltage of 80V for 2 hours.
